premises.text: People planning a social occasion think of two things: their mood and who is coming with them
premises.evidence_span: when planning any social occasion, think of two things. What's my mood and who's coming with me

premises.text: No existing product tells people which places and events go together for their occasion
premises.evidence_span: not a single product on the market today that can tell you what places and what events go together for your occasion

premises.text: People want review snippets of what is new, fresh, and happening in their area
premises.evidence_span: they wanted review snippets of what's new and fresh and happening in the area

premises.text: An algorithmic engine classifies, ranks, and composes places and events from across the web into itineraries on the fly, never hand-curated
premises.evidence_span: algorithmically classifying them, ranking them, and on the fly, composing them into itineraries to fit my needs

premises.text: Users can reshape plans with real-time advice from friends pulled in via Facebook
premises.evidence_span: They all get a Facebook notification saying I've asked them for some advice on my WeOtta plan

premises.text: A plan converts into a Facebook event in seconds with all places, invites, and booking links attached
premises.evidence_span: That happened in less than two seconds

domains.name: How people plan and the market gap

value.text: People get complete, hassle-free plans for what to do tonight, tailored to their occasion
value.evidence_span: It solves the problem of what to do tonight. It also takes all the hassle out of planning it

causal_links.evidence_span: What's my mood and who's coming with me
composing them into itineraries to fit my needs
it's even easier than making a Facebook event on Facebook site itself

notes: Mid-pitch audience interjections treated as Q&A content and excluded per 4.2.5; the 'never curated' claim is coded from the founder's summary line instead. Review-site, directions, and booking-link integrations folded into the engine and event premises as features of one offering (v1.3.2 clarification 5). No monetization content present in the transcript, so none coded. Uber Cab tweet promotion excluded as audience appeal. Singleton D2 retained: the ranking/composition engine is the core independently learnable mechanism with its own claimed contribution to value.
